action: No action needed; for awareness. Organisations that depend on weather service data feeds should confirm that those feeds are current.
exec: A second federal communications problem on the same day as the FAA halt; no link or cyber cause has been reported.
plain: The US National Weather Service said it had nationwide internet and communications problems on November 13, the same day as the flight halt. Nothing so far links the two or points to an attack.
summary: The weather service said on November 13, the day of the FAA ground stop, that it was experiencing nationwide internet and communications problems. There was no immediate indication the two were connected, and no cyber cause has been reported.
title: US National Weather Service reports nationwide internet and communications issues
